baseline_ids: primitive 40^3/80^3 EOS supported in its own cell
nano k3 transfer checked here, not previously certified

k_gate.delta_definition: [(E1-E0)_k5 - (E1-E0)_k3] at each existing k3 equilibrium geometry; same bulk mu cancels
k_gate.failure_action: Fail gate job (nonzero); dependent six relaxations do not start. No automatic k7/re-relax/submission. Review the residual force and energy sensitivity.
k_gate.scope: Representative R15 check at old final geometries; 5 meV is this work practical decision threshold, not a universal convergence law. Does not certify all radii, smearing, vacuum or axial-length convergence.

resources.memory_note: R15 observed QE estimate >72.60/72.10 GB and successful 128 GiB allocations; R20 >156.45/155.76 GB and measured ~177.96 GiB/256 GiB. R17 allocation is a size-interpolated conservative request, not a measured peak. Denser-k R15 given extra headroom; QE estimates are lower bounds.

checkpoint_policy: Retain full scratch and .bfgs under unique attempt_001. Internal max_seconds stops 1h before allocation wall. No automatic restart; subsequent continuation must verify density/wfc/BFGS consistency and explicitly use startingpot/wfc=file.
